name: Freginals (Spain)
description: White field charged with three green trefoils arranged two and one.
history: The official flag of Freginals is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, white, with three green trefoils arranged two and one as they appear on the arms; approved on 13 June 1990 and published in the DOGC.

features.role: three trefoils, two above and one below
